description: Delete one of the user's saved searches and stop its email alerts. Pass saved_search_id from getmattered_list_saved_searches. This cannot be undone, so call it only when the user asks to delete that search, and name the search first. The user's job preferences and matches do not change. Do not use it only to turn alerts off; use getmattered_update_saved_search. Next: getmattered_list_saved_searches.
name: getmattered_delete_saved_search

alertsEnabled.description: True when new matches for this search are emailed to the user.

savedSearchId.description: Pass as saved_search_id to getmattered_update_saved_search or getmattered_delete_saved_search.

saved.description: From getmattered_create_saved_search or getmattered_update_saved_search: the search after the change.
